author: [deleted]
body: Must be the SAME tier as you, so if your level 200 at tier 9 you need to fight a T9 boss using only what it's weak to. So if it's weak to holt, only using holy magic and nothing else. I think there is some acception for pet damage but not sure about summons. Class has no affect on your overall tier, it's just a requirement to unlock the class, only your level dictates your tier.
